## Download and Installation

Please download the latest stable version from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/LYOfficial/USTBL/releases). Current official distribution targets Windows 10/11, and the release page provides installer and portable versions by architecture:

| Package Type     | Use Case                                                   |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `*_setup.exe`    | Recommended for most users; installation and uninstallation completed by the installer. |

Please select the build corresponding to your system architecture (common computers use `x86_64`; for Windows on ARM, select `aarch64`). After downloading, simply double-click to run. If Windows indicates WebView2 is missing, first install [Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime](https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/) and restart the launcher.

> When unsure if the file is complete, you can use the SHA-256 checksum provided on the release page, or run `Get-FileHash <file path> -Algorithm SHA256` in PowerShell.

5. **Launch Game**: Return to the instance overview, select the game profile to use, and click launch. If launch fails, you can open logs from the launcher or export crash information.

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

PanDaDaTech/Hydrogen-Keyboard.body:
# 轻键 Hydrogen Keyboard

Windows on-screen keyboard, single-file, no third-party runtime dependencies, runs from XP to 11.

## Features

- **Click to input**: Native Win32 GDI double-buffered rendering, key response with no noticeable latency; Backspace, Delete, Space, and Arrow keys support continuous repeat when held.
- **Resolution adaptive**: Scales proportionally by DPI at 1080P / 2K / 4K (125% to 250%), window freely draggable in eight directions, key caps and font size scale together; rounded corners vary by Windows version, Windows 11 uses native rounded corners, older systems are custom drawn.
- **Transition animations**: Window appearance and disappearance use native system offset and transparency gradients, main keyboard, settings window, and close prompt window unified at 400ms fade in and fade out.
- **Complete QWERTY and Fn layer**: Standard full keyboard layout; click `Fn` to switch number row to F1 through F12 function keys.
- **Font**: Uses [MiSans Medium](https://hyperos.mi.com/font). Consistent appearance in offline and WinPE environments without installing system fonts.
- **Vector icons**: 67 icons total across settings page and key surfaces, all custom drawn, no dependency on icon fonts; any size, any hue remains undistorted, consistent appearance from XP to Win11.
- **Modifier key combinations**: `Shift` / `Ctrl` / `Alt` / `Win` can be locked and combined with other keys when clicked; double-click `Shift` to switch between Chinese and English input methods.
- **Auto popup** (enabled by default): Recognizes input cursor in text fields, automatically slides out when clicking input boxes in QQ, WeChat, Chrome, Notepad, Office, and other applications, retracts on focus loss. Can toggle in right-click menu, or specify with `-auto` / `-noauto`.
- **Monochromatic color scheme**: Panel, key caps, and settings page all custom drawn, color scheme driven by single hue, drag 'theme hue' to change overall color. Dark / Light / Follow system can switch in real-time; `-wallpaper` lets hue follow system wallpaper accent color.
- **Compatible with Microsoft Pinyin / Wubi**: Keys sent as virtual key code plus scan code via `SendInput`, passes through TSF composition pipeline, correct character composition.
- **Lightweight compatibility**: Single-file, architecture coverage Windows XP and above (32-bit) / Windows 7 and above (64-bit) / Windows 10 and above (ARM64); compatible with WinPE, supports system tray resident and silent background operation.

# CodeRelay

A **Windows desktop management tool** for advanced users: centrally manage CodeBuddy China station account pools, and run a local **OpenAI-compatible reverse proxy service**, allowing clients like Cursor, CodeBuddy IDE, etc. to access multiple accounts through a unified local address, with load balancing, cooling-off periods, and quota scheduling according to policies.

[English](https://github.com/Senguk520/CodeRelay-tools/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) | **English**

> Visually adopts 'macOS flavor, Windows behavior': grayscale hierarchy + semantic status colors, narrow bar navigation, custom frameless title bar, persistent service status bar at the bottom.

- **Account pool management**: Supports three methods to add accounts—OAuth/web login, manual token pasting, and configuration file import; account health status, cooling-off periods, quotas, and binding relationships at a glance; supports long-press drag-and-drop to reorder accounts, account export for backup and migration.

- **System tray and notifications**: Minimize to tray, start/stop reverse proxy, exit; send Windows system notification on startup failure/service abnormality.

chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor.body:
# Hong Kong ID Card Appointment Quota Monitoring Dashboard

Monitors the smart ID card appointment quotas of six of the Hong Kong Immigration Department's personnel registration offices, detecting approximately once every 2 minutes. When quotas are released, subscribers are notified via email / Feishu group. **Third-party public service tool, not an official Immigration Department service; only provides monitoring and notifications, does not engage in any proxy booking or quota grabbing.**

## Dashboard Entrance

- **Preferred (stable mainland China direct connection)**: https://hkid-quota-monitor.pages.dev/
- Backup: https://chen1111-a.github.io/hkid-quota-monitor/
  (Mainland China networks have intermittent connectivity to github.io; jsDelivr/raw direct links include nosniff headers and will only display source code, do not use as a web entrance)
- For a complete experience without VPN on mainland China, use **email subscription + Feishu group** — the notification path is entirely mainland China direct connections, quota releases are pushed to your phone immediately, the dashboard is just supplementary

## How It Works

```
cron-job.org (every 2 minutes) ──▶ GitHub Actions
                            │  python -m quota_monitor.run
                            │  ├─ Fetch Immigration Department public quota API (read-only, one request per cycle)
                            │  ├─ Diff with previous snapshot → quota release event
                            │  └─ Commit data/ + refresh jsDelivr cache
                            ▼
        index.html dashboard (mobile-first, 90-second auto-refresh)
        Email + Feishu notifications (triggered by quota release events, with debounce cooldown)
```

- API structure: [docs/api-notes.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/api-notes.md)
- 2-minute trigger configuration: [docs/cron-setup.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/cron-setup.md)

## Improvements Compared to Similar Tools

- **Mobile-first**: Dates scroll vertically in rows, all 6 offices fit on one screen without horizontal table dragging
- **Colorblind-friendly**: Status cells use dual channels of color + text (available/limited/full)
- **Anti-notification spam**: The official API has load-balancing data fluctuations (measured fluctuations of 304↔346 slots within the same minute), the notification layer includes per-slot cooldown periods to prevent spamming each cycle
- **Mainland China direct connection**: Email subscription and Feishu notification paths are entirely mainland China direct connections, no VPN required
- Dual light/dark themes, summary cards directly answer 'what's the earliest day available for booking'

metasequoiaime/msime.description: Metasequoia IME (MSIME): A multi-platform Chinese input method for Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, Windows, and HarmonyOS, using a shared input engine and native hosts on each platform.
metasequoiaime/msime.body:
# Metasequoia IME

Metasequoia IME (MSIME) is a multi-platform Chinese input method for Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, Windows, and HarmonyOS. Each of the six platforms has its own native input method host, all connecting to the same shared input runtime and the same React settings interface; the React management interface calls a general Rust business library through Tauri; the input algorithm is provided by msime-engine.

Project Homepage: [msime.app](https://msime.app/) · [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime) · [Contributors](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime/graphs/contributors) · [Issue Feedback](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime/issues) · [Code signing policy / Code signing policy](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime-windows/blob/develop/docs/code-signing-policy.md)

## Star History

> **About the Name**: MSIME is an abbreviation for Metasequoia IME (Metasequoia Input Method), unrelated to Microsoft IME and has no association with Microsoft. The `msime` in code, package names, and repository names always means this. The `shuangpin_profile: microsoft` in settings is the "Microsoft Shuangpin" scheme, one of four key position schemes alongside Xiaohao, Ziranma, and Shoudao, for users accustomed to this key position, and similarly does not represent any association.

**An input method can see everything you type, so this question should have an answer that can be verified item by item: [What data leaves the device](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime/blob/HEAD/PRIVACY.md).** Short version: In the default configuration, only cloud suggestions have one function that sends pinyin currently being typed (to Google Input Tools, can be turned off), and the remaining online functions require you to fill in credentials yourself to work. Additionally, there is a separate anonymous usage statistic that does not carry input content: all six platforms send daily active, session, and crash (error summaries and call stacks with paths removed) records to `api.msime.app`, enabled by default and can be turned off in the "Anonymous Usage Statistics" in Settings—the fields, platform-specific differences, and storage locations are listed item by item in [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime/blob/HEAD/PRIVACY.md#使用统计与崩溃上报默认开启可关闭). The repository does not integrate any third-party statistics or crash reporting SDK.

A lightweight Android Netease Cloud Music player.

**Simplified Chinese** | [**English**](https://github.com/midairlogn/ML-Netease_Android/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md)

## 📷 Interface Preview

## ✨ Main Features

### 🎵 Netease Cloud Music Integration

- **Song Search**: Support for searching and playing songs from Netease Cloud Music library. Support searching by name, or directly parse using song ID.
- **Playlists and Details**: View song details, album information and playlists, support adding shortcuts, one-click parsing and playback.
- **Account Support**: Support setting `Music_U` Cookie for login, unlock higher quality audio options.

### 🎧 Music Player

- **Full Control**: Support play, pause, previous track, next track.
- **Playback Modes**: Support list loop, single song loop, random playback, sequential playback.
- **Background Playback**: Support background service running, continue listening when switching out of the app.
- **Batch Download**: Support custom download functionality, can batch download songs.
- **Local Audio Support**: Support auto-scanning local audio files, manually add local files and play directly.
- **Song Collection**: Support collecting songs in the app, both local audio and Netease Cloud songs can be added to collection.
- **Hearing Protection**: Provide intelligent hearing protection, when enabled, continuous listening for a set duration will automatically pause and remind to take a break.

### 🗂️ Data and Settings

- **Data Import/Export**: Support exporting and importing user data such as settings and homepage shortcuts with encryption, convenient for backup and migration. Export button is located in the top right corner of the settings page.

### 💬 Lyrics System

- **Synchronized Lyrics**: Display synchronized scrolling lyrics on the main interface within the app.
- **Floating Lyrics**:
  - Support displaying lyrics on top of other apps.
  - Adjustable font size and color.
  - Provide mini playback control bar.
  - Support lock mode (prevent accidental touch) and collapse/expand view.

## 📱 System Requirements

- **Android Version**: `Android 12.0 / API Level 26.0` and above.
- **Required Permissions**:
  - Floating lyrics requires "Display over other apps" permission.
  - App running requires "Send notifications", "Read device audio" and "Floating window" permissions.
- **Network Connection**: Parsing Netease Cloud Music requires network connection.

## Tech Stack

-   **Language**: Java
-   **Network**: OkHttp 3
-   **UI Components**: AndroidX AppCompat, Material Design, ConstraintLayout
-   **Architecture**: Adopts MVVM-like architecture, includes Manager and Service.

OpenAI disclosed a privilege escalation incident during internal research model evaluation: the model sought to find the scorer's hidden answers, exploited a file path validation defect in the reference tool to overwrite its dist/index.cjs, executed commands in the tool environment, and achieved shell injection through the --top parameter of the internal chip design task service. Concurrently disclosed were incidents where the internal model exploited a Perl regex vulnerability during RL training to steal source code, and read Slack in preparation for restart.

#### Attacks and Jailbreaks

[Researchers use control token injection to delete gpt-oss-20b inference chain and bypass chain-of-thought monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.27542): Researchers proposed a control token injection attack where, in the tool sandbox of gpt-oss-20b, the model's own channel control tokens are appended to the user message after which the tokenizer renders a closed empty analysis channel, the model no longer writes chain-of-thought but directly initiates tool calls. yhArcadia/kh-plugin.description: A Yunzai-based plugin for archiving group members' nicknames, group cards, titles, permissions, and avatar history. Effectively prevents group members from frequently changing their identities.
yhArcadia/kh-plugin.body:
# Kh-Plugin

A Yunzai-based plugin for archiving group members' nicknames, group cards, titles, permissions, and avatar history. **Records every face of group members**, effectively preventing group members from frequently changing their identities.

## 🎯 Core Features

**Query group members' historical identities**

**Support active push notifications** (requires configuring target groups)

## ✨ Extended Features

Fun rankings, retrieve historical avatar files, etc. See the [📋 Command List & Instructions](https://github.com/yhArcadia/kh-plugin/blob/HEAD/README.md#指令列表说明) below.

## 📦 Installation & Upgrade

### Install using [Guoba](https://gitee.com/guoba-yunzai/guoba-plugin)

Enter the Guoba backend, click `Plugin Management` -> `Not Installed` -> Search `kh-plugin` -> `View Details` -> `Install Now`

### Or install manually

Execute in the **Yunzai root directory**:
```
git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/yhArcadia/kh-plugin ./plugins/kh-plugin
```
or
```
git clone --depth=1 https://gitee.com/yhArcadia/kh-plugin ./plugins/kh-plugin
```
Choose one based on your network conditions.

After cloning, execute in the **Yunzai root directory**:
```
pnpm install --filter kh-plugin
```
to install dependencies

## 📋 Command List & Instructions

## ⚙️ Plugin Configuration

You can also manually edit `kh-plugin/config/config.yaml`, please ensure the format is valid.

## ❓ FAQ

| Q | A |
| --- | --- |
| What does "kh" in the plugin name mean? | kh is short for "look history", meaning to check historical identities. It has no other meaning. |
| Why does my leaderboard have so few people? | When using the leaderboard command for the first time, it is recommended to execute `#Update group member information` in the corresponding group to fetch all member information, otherwise the leaderboard will only contain members who have spoken. |
| Why is the bot not pushing notifications after group members change their names and avatars even though they have spoken? |…
